subject.title: feat(mattermost): read channel history with guarded permissions

question: Should existing Mattermost installations receive agent-accessible channel-history reads by default, or should `channels.mattermost.actions.messages` require explicit opt-in until that data-access expansion is approved?
rationale: This PR changes what existing configured agents can retrieve, so the default is a product and data-access boundary rather than a mechanical implementation detail.

options.title: Require explicit opt-in first
options.body: Default `actions.messages` to disabled and enable it only when the operator explicitly opts in, while preserving the provider's guarded authorization model.

options.title: Approve default enablement
options.body: Keep the default enabled, but document the upgrade behavior and obtain live proof that direct and delegated authorization boundaries work on an installed plugin.

recommendation.title: Require explicit opt-in first
recommendation.body: Default `actions.messages` to disabled and enable it only when the operator explicitly opts in, while preserving the provider's guarded authorization model.

likelyOwner.reason: The Mattermost plugin ownership history makes this the strongest available decision-routing candidate.
